title: Static
summary: Something is hiding under the New Horizons signal. Find someone who can hear it.

steps.text: Take the New Horizons recording to the Bessel Archive
Recover the Ninefold's flight recorder

title: The Quiet Camp
summary: The Ninefold sold its scrap to a mining camp on Cinder. The camp went quiet last spring.

steps.text: Search Tallis Camp on Cinder

title: Two Voices
summary: There's a second signal, from the Oort Cloud, and it's a warning. Find where it comes from.

steps.text: Take a reading at Barnard's Star (the Halcyon Array)
Take a reading at Alpha Centauri
Take the last reading at Sirius

title: The Race Begins
summary: Everyone wants what your ship can do. Hear them out, then decide who to trust.

steps.text: Hear Aurum Meridian's offer at Sirius Gate
Answer the Academy's summons at Tranquility
Find Auntie Vesper in the Sump, under New Geneva
Decide who to trust

title: Beyond the Oort
summary: The source of the warning is out past Sol's Oort Cloud. Go and see what's been whispering at our door.

steps.text: Fly out to the beacon, far beyond Sol's planets

title: The Echo
summary: Survey Camp Seven's radio keeps hearing its own voice come back, days late, from somewhere empty.

board.text: Survey Camp Seven at Lalande 21185 is paying a captain to look at "a radio problem." Their words. They sound scared.

steps.text: Talk to Chief Brooks at Survey Camp Seven
Board the old consortium yard in orbit
Tell Chief Brooks what you found

title: Sleepwalkers
summary: Miners on Proxima b's night side are walking out onto the ice in their sleep.

board.text: The medic at Darkside Camp, Proxima b, needs a captain "who isn't afraid of the dark." Paying in cash and favors.

steps.text: Find Dr. Ferro at Darkside Camp
Stay up for the night shift at Darkside Camp

title: Lights Out Under Europa
summary: Europa Deep found something in the ocean. Now they need someone they can trust with it.

board.text: Europa Deep Station wants a pilot with a quiet ship for "a sensitive survey." No reporters.

steps.text: Meet Dr. Ness at Europa Deep
Decide what to do with what they found

title: The Terminator Run
summary: Juno Ashe can't race without her nav core, and she knows exactly who took it.

board.text: A racer at Terminator City is offering a cut of her winnings to anyone with a fast ship and no fear of sunlight.

steps.text: Find Juno Ashe in Terminator City
Get Juno's nav core back from Kade Marlow at Darkside Camp
Bring the nav core back to Juno

title: Whispering Cargo
summary: Dez Moreau has a crate he wants gone, far from anyone, and he won't say why.

board.text: A trader on the Ring at Barnard's Star needs a crate disposed of, discreetly and far from anyone. Pays well. Asks no questions; would like the same.

steps.text: Meet Dez Moreau on the Ring at Barnard's Star
Take the crate somewhere nobody will ever find it
Tell Dez it's done

title: Letters from Pilgrim's Field
summary: A woman hiding among the monks of Tau Ceti needs a letter carried to her sister.

board.text: Someone at Pilgrim's Field, Tau Ceti, needs a letter carried. The monks say she's been waiting for the right captain.

steps.text: Meet Vesna at Pilgrim's Field
Deliver Vesna's letter to Mira in Verdance
Bring Mira's reply back to Pilgrim's Field
